meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装后,rkt 会被挂进 agent 容器,每次 Bash 调用都由 PreToolUse 钩子自动经 rtk 过滤,git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令输出被压缩,token 消耗减少 60–90%,无需在 CLAUDE.md 里写指令。
howto.when: 当你想给某个 agent group 装上 rtk,让它的 Bash 调用被自动过滤时使用;装好后每次 Bash 工具调用由 PreToolUse 钩子接管。

say.text: 跑一下 git status,看看 rtk 有没有生效
say.note: rtk 会静默拦截这条命令

say.text: 再运行 pytest,看看输出有没有被压缩
say.note: 命令经 rtk 过滤后执行

say.text: 运行 rtk gain 看看省了多少 token

howto.what_en: After rtk is installed into agent containers, every Bash tool call is routed through rtk via the PreToolUse hook, compressing git, cargo, pytest and other dev command output for 60–90% token savings — no CLAUDE.md instructions needed.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to install rtk into an agent group so its Bash calls are filtered automatically; once set up, the PreToolUse hook takes over on every Bash call.

say_en.text: Run git status and see if rtk kicks in
Now run pytest to check the compression
Run rtk gain to see tokens saved
